# Decision memo: Prioritize playback reliability and offline listening next quarter

## Recommendation
Invest next quarter in **playback**, focusing on playback/connectivity reliability and downloads. The area has 8 complaints, a mean severity of 3.75, and 6 severity-4-or-5 complaints. Its top issue, ISS-playback-general, has a priority score of 19 [C1], with reports of connectivity failures, assistant playback not starting, and playback stopping unexpectedly. This is a focused product problem with substantial reported severity; the evidence supports prioritizing it, not a claim about downstream retention or revenue.

## Evidence
ISS-playback-general records 5 complaints and a priority score of 19 [C1]. ## Alternatives considered
Billing/support has more area-level complaints (11) than playback (8), but its mean severity is 2.82 and it has no severity-4-or-5 complaints. Its leading issue, ISS-billing-paywall, has priority score 24 [C3], so it merits attention; however, playback combines high severity with more severe complaints at the area level. Usability also has more area-level complaints (13), but mean severity is 2.77. Its leading issue, ISS-usability-controls, has priority score 10 [C4], lower than playback's leading issue. Access has only 2 area-level complaints, despite a 4.00 mean severity, making it a narrower signal in this pack.
